generationMode: Generated by a separate agent from the written specification in docs/art/SLIDESHOW-BRIEF.md. The prompts that agent composed were not captured in this repository; the brief is the specification of record.

assets.name: title-board
assets.visualAssessment: Nineteen hexes in the 3-4-5-4-3 arrangement with exactly one desert, cream number tokens with pips, roads and settlements in the four house colours, harbour jetties and boats around the coast, on a walnut table with resource cards and dice to the right. Two departures from how the game draws a board: red numerals appear on 5 and 9 as well as on 6 and 8, where Catanova reddens only 6 and 8; and the 3 tokens carry one pip rather than two. No robber is present. At background scale behind the entry card these are not legible.
assets.copyValidation: SHA-256 of the saved master matches the generated original byte for byte.

assets.name: title-harbour
assets.visualAssessment: A bay at golden hour with a jetty and moored sailing boat to the right, a beached rowing boat and stone quay to the left, crates and a wheat sheaf on the boards. The centre is open water, which is what the entry card sits over. Finish is closer to classical landscape painting than the storybook handling of title-landscape, but the palette and light match.
assets.copyValidation: SHA-256 of the saved master matches the generated original byte for byte.

assets.name: title-table-dusk
assets.visualAssessment: Walnut table after dark under two out-of-focus lanterns. Resource cards and dice in the lower left, board edge running off the top, pieces in four house colours, a bowl of resource tokens to the right. The centre is plain lit table. Follows the brief most closely of the three.
assets.copyValidation: SHA-256 of the saved master matches the generated original byte for byte.

assets.name: guide-game-view
assets.visualAssessment: The same island as title-board with four player cards down the right, each with a portrait, a name and its held resources and trophy. Carries the same two token departures as title-board: red numerals on 5 and 9, and one pip on the 3 tokens. This matters more here than on a background, because the guide is read for instruction and does refer to red number tokens.
